title: Model Supply Velocity & Partner Compatibility Synthesis
creator: Leah Chen
description: Synthesize a repeatable signal that captures: (1) velocity of new model releases across open and hosted ecosystems, (2) integration compatibility with Redwood's runtime (tokenizer/ops/quantization readiness), and (3) partner readiness/contracting friction. The output will be a scored index and a decision rubric to prioritize engineering onboarding, commercial outreach, and capacity planning. This ticket scopes the research, prototype scoring model, and initial dashboard wireframe.
background: We currently track model availability and feature headlines, but lack a unified view that predicts how quickly a new model can realistically be onboarded and served by customers. Sales and Platform teams need a triage signal that combines technical integration effort, legal/licensing risk, and market momentum to prioritize limited engineering capacity and Commercial partner conversations.
deliverables: Technical integration scoring rubric (tokenizer mismatch, op support, quantization-compatibility, expected runtime changes)
Partner friction score (licensing type, pricing opacity, contract lead time, availability in APAC/EU)
Model Supply Velocity Index (time-to-first-stable-release trend + community adoption signals)
Prototype dashboard in Looker/Metabase with weekly refresh
Runbook for when index >= threshold to trigger onboarding spike or alert to sales
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric reviewed and approved by Applied ML and Runtime Eng
Dashboard shows historical velocity for top 50 models and is refreshable
Three representative model onboarding case studies mapped to rubric with elapsed times
Product and Sales stakeholders sign off on prioritization recommendations
